question.problem: If $a_{n+1}=2a_n-3$ with $a_1=4,$ then find the value of $a_2.$
question.worked_solution:
The recursive formula is

$$
a_{n+1}=2a_n - 3
$$

where $a_1={\color{blue}4}.$

We compute $a_2$ by substituting $n=1$ into the recursive formula:

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{n+1} & =2{a}_{n}-3 \\ {a}_{1+1} & =2{a}_{1}-3 \\ {a}_{2} & =2{a}_{1}-3 \\ {a}_{2} & =2(4)-3 \\ {a}_{2} & =5\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $a_2=5.$
